patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Jira only if your buying job matches “Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo ” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Jira's shape. Workflow advantage: Jira leans shared coverage; Smartsheet leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Jira is Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo annual.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Jira-leaning — vs Smartsheet-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Jira — Steep learning curve outside engineering; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Jira: Steep learning curve outside engineering; Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Jira is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Steep learning curve outside engineering · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Jira if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
